review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — The runtime test edits entry 1. It asserts configured review-at-pr, effective supervised, and an 'entry 1: contents don't match its seal' problem.
- A2: met — The test rewrites the header to name the factory runtime. It asserts ledger.md is re-rendered, verify().ok is true, verification is empty and effective is review-at-pr.
- A3: met — Tests cover a non-JSON line and RIVETARI_LEDGER_KEY=not-a-key. ladder() and enforceFallback() resolve, report supervised, and leave ledger.jsonl byte-identical.
- A4: met — The CLI test checks renderLadder and sessionStartText for the failure line, the entry problem and 'runs supervised'. It checks none of it appears for intact or absent ledgers.
- A5: met — Only new test files are added.

<details><summary>5 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Session start drops the ledger warning silently when ladder() throws `packages/cli/src/commands/hook.ts:632` — On rejection, push a line such as `(The trust ladder can't be read: <reason>; treat this repo as supervised.)` instead of nothing.
- rerenderView failures are reported as 'ledger.jsonl can't be read' `packages/runtime/src/task/ladder.ts:120` — Catch rerenderView separately and word its problem as the view not being re-renderable, or use a neutral message naming the autonomy ledger.
- Problems are listed twice in rivetari metrics `packages/cli/src/commands/metrics.ts:49` — In ladder(), set fallback to a short 'the autonomy ledger failed verification' without the joined problems, and let verificationLines carry the list.
- New required `verification` field may break existing LadderState literals `packages/runtime/src/task/ladder.ts:67` — Confirm the deterministic checks are green. If a literal exists, make verificationLines tolerate a missing field (`l.verification ?? []`) rather than editing the old test.
- CLI test doesn't isolate RIVETARI_LEDGER_KEY `packages/cli/src/commands/ladder-verify.test.ts:24` — Save, delete and restore RIVETARI_LEDGER_KEY in beforeEach and afterEach, as the runtime test does.

</details>

_Not reviewed: `packages/action/dist/SOURCE_SHA256` (generated), `packages/action/dist/index.js` (generated)._

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: Session start drops the ledger warning silently when ladder() throws
suggestions.detail: verifiedEntries already catches ledger errors. But ladder() can still reject from historyRows or loadBanned, and `.catch(() => null)` then prints nothing. The person sees no hint that the trust ladder couldn't be read. This fails open on display, though enforcement is unaffected.
suggestions.repro: Make historyRows(root) reject, for example with a corrupt metrics history, while the autonomy ledger is tampered. The session-start text omits the failed-verification lines.
suggestions.fix: On rejection, push a line such as `(The trust ladder can't be read: <reason>; treat this repo as supervised.)` instead of nothing.

suggestions.title: rerenderView failures are reported as 'ledger.jsonl can't be read'
suggestions.detail: One try block wraps rerenderView(), verify() and entries(). A failure to write ledger.md, such as EACCES or a read-only checkout, is attributed to ledger.jsonl, which points the person at the wrong file.
suggestions.repro: Make .rivetari/autonomy/ledger.md read-only with a stale header, then run `rivetari metrics`. The problem says ledger.jsonl can't be read.
suggestions.fix: Catch rerenderView separately and word its problem as the view not being re-renderable, or use a neutral message naming the autonomy ledger.

suggestions.title: Problems are listed twice in rivetari metrics
suggestions.detail: With verification failing and configured above supervised, the Autonomy line already prints `(running at supervised: the autonomy ledger failed verification: <problems>)`. verificationLines then lists the same problems again just below.
suggestions.repro: Run `rivetari metrics` on a review-at-pr repo with an edited entry. The entry problem appears on the Autonomy line and again as a bullet.
suggestions.fix: In ladder(), set fallback to a short 'the autonomy ledger failed verification' without the joined problems, and let verificationLines carry the list.

suggestions.title: New required `verification` field may break existing LadderState literals
suggestions.detail: Any existing test or caller that builds a LadderState by hand now fails typecheck. At runtime it would also throw in renderLadder on `l.verification.length`. The card forbids changing existing tests.
suggestions.repro: Run `pnpm run typecheck` with any existing test that passes an object literal to renderLadder.
suggestions.fix: Confirm the deterministic checks are green. If a literal exists, make verificationLines tolerate a missing field (`l.verification ?? []`) rather than editing the old test.

suggestions.title: CLI test doesn't isolate RIVETARI_LEDGER_KEY
suggestions.detail: The runtime test clears RIVETARI_LEDGER_KEY, but the CLI test doesn't. A developer or CI environment with that variable set changes which key signs and verifies the ledger, so the test can behave differently from one machine to the next.
suggestions.repro: Run `RIVETARI_LEDGER_KEY=not-a-key pnpm run test`. The intact-ledger case reports a failed verification.
suggestions.fix: Save, delete and restore RIVETARI_LEDGER_KEY in beforeEach and afterEach, as the runtime test does.
